start: An owner on a laptop and a Staff person on the desk phone, both signed in to the same online gym

steps.action: The owner takes a fee payment from a member
user_sees: A receipt with the next receipt number
The member page shows the payment
must_not: A receipt number already used
The payment saved twice

steps.action: The Staff person looks at the same member within about a quarter of a minute
user_sees: The same payment and the same dues
must_not: Old dues still shown after the refresh
A second copy of the payment

steps.action: The Staff person takes a payment from another member
user_sees: A receipt with the number after the owner’s
must_not: The same receipt number as the owner’s receipt

start: An owner importing a long member list into an online gym, too big for one save

steps.action: Start the import
user_sees: The members are saved in several parts
must_not: A member saved twice across two parts

steps.action: The internet fails after the first part
user_sees: A message that names how many members were already saved
must_not: 'No new members were saved' although some were
The saved part rolled back without a word

steps.action: Run the same import again
user_sees: The members already in read as already a member; the rest are added
must_not: The first part added a second time

start: An owner saving while another desk saves at the very same moment, or with no internet

steps.action: Save a change at the same moment as another desk, several times in a row
user_sees: The change saved on top of the other desk’s, or after repeated clashes: 'Someone else is saving at the same time. Please try again.'
must_not: The other desk’s change wiped out
A success message for a change that was not saved

steps.action: Change a plan price with the internet off
user_sees: 'No internet, so this can't be saved now. Check-ins, payments and new members still work. Try this again when the internet is back.'
must_not: The price shown as changed
The change sent later without the owner knowing

steps.action: Use the panel after the owner key stopped working on this device
user_sees: The sign-in page
must_not: The gym’s records left readable on this device
An endless error on every save

start: An owner taking a payment when the reply from the server is lost on the way

steps.action: Tap save on the payment sheet; the internet drops before the answer
user_sees: 'The internet dropped while saving, so it may not have gone through yet. It is kept on this device and sent when the internet is back. Don't take this payment again: it shows on the member's page.'
must_not: A plain "failed" with no word on what to do
The payment missing from the member page

steps.action: Press the same sheet again
user_sees: The same receipt handed back, or 'A payment for this member is still being sent. When the internet is back, check the member's page before you take money again.'
must_not: A second receipt with a new number for the same money

steps.action: Start another action when the internet is back
user_sees: 'Your last change was saved just now (the internet came back). Check the screen before doing it again.'
must_not: The new action run on top without the owner seeing the late save
The late save lost

steps.action: Cancel the receipt, then undo a plan cancellation made by mistake
user_sees: Both desks show the receipt as cancelled and the plan as active again
must_not: One desk still showing the old state after its refresh

start: An owner of one gym signed in on a device

steps.action: Open Members and Money
user_sees: Only this gym’s members, plans and receipts
must_not: A member, a receipt or a count from another gym

steps.action: Look at a receipt the Staff person took
user_sees: The name of the Staff person who took the money
must_not: The owner named as taker of money someone else took

start: Two Staff people on two desk devices of the same online gym, each with a different member

steps.action: Both tap save on a payment at the same moment
user_sees: Each gets a receipt; the two receipt numbers follow one another
must_not: Two receipts with the same number
One of the two payments lost

steps.action: Each looks at the other’s member after a short wait
user_sees: The other desk’s payment and the new dues
must_not: Dues that still count the paid money as owed

start: Two Staff people adding the same new member (same mobile number) at two desks

steps.action: Desk A saves the new member
user_sees: The member is added
must_not: A refusal for a mobile nobody has

steps.action: Desk B saves a member with the same mobile a moment later
user_sees: A plain message that this mobile already belongs to a member, naming them
must_not: Two members with the same mobile
Desk B told it saved

start: A Staff person at the desk

steps.action: Take a second payment from a member whose first payment has no answer from the server yet
user_sees: 'A payment for this member is still being sent. When the internet is back, check the member's page before you take money again.'
must_not: A second receipt for the same dues

steps.action: Save a member change with the internet off on a device with no room left to keep it
user_sees: 'Nothing was saved: this device is out of space. Free up space, or try again when the internet is back.'
must_not: The change shown as saved
The change lost with a success message

steps.action: Try something only an owner may save (cancel a receipt) by any route
user_sees: A plain refusal
must_not: The server keeping a Staff person’s cancel

start: A Staff person who checked a member in and took a payment

steps.action: Check the same member in again on the same day from the other desk
user_sees: One check-in for the day
must_not: Two visits counted for one day

steps.action: The owner cancels the receipt on another device
user_sees: After the refresh the desk shows the receipt as cancelled and the dues back
must_not: The desk still showing the money as paid
The desk’s next save bringing the cancelled receipt back to life

steps.action: Undo the check-in
user_sees: The visit gone on both desks
must_not: The visit back again after the other desk saves

start: A Staff person signed in at one branch of a gym with branches

steps.action: Open Members and take a payment
user_sees: Only this branch’s members; the receipt number starts with this branch’s own code
The receipt names this Staff person as taker
must_not: Members or receipts of another branch or another gym
A receipt number another branch could also print

start: A trainer signed in on a phone; the front desk signed in on the desk computer

steps.action: Make a workout plan for a member and send it
user_sees: The plan shows as sent on the member
must_not: The plan saved twice from one tap

steps.action: The front desk opens the same member after a short wait
user_sees: The same workout plan
must_not: No plan, or an older text of it

start: A trainer saving a workout plan

steps.action: Save with the internet off
user_sees: 'No internet, so this can't be saved now. Check-ins, payments and new members still work. Try this again when the internet is back.'
must_not: The plan shown as sent to the member
The typed plan thrown away without a word

steps.action: Save at the same moment as the desk saves a payment, again and again
user_sees: The plan saved, or 'Someone else is saving at the same time. Please try again.'
must_not: The desk’s payment lost because the trainer saved

start: A trainer who sent a workout plan to a member

steps.action: Change the plan and save
user_sees: The new text on both devices
must_not: Two plans for the member where one was changed

steps.action: Withdraw the plan
user_sees: The plan shows as withdrawn on the trainer’s phone and on the desk
must_not: The desk still showing it as sent
The plan coming back after the desk’s next save

start: A trainer signed in to the panel

steps.action: Open the pages a trainer may open
user_sees: Members and workout plans of this gym only
must_not: Money totals or expenses
Records of another gym

start: The panel of an online gym, one desk saving a change

steps.action: A desk saves a payment
user_sees: Only the changed rows go to the server, named against the version the desk last saw
The server answers with a new version; the desk shows the saved payment
must_not: The whole gym sent on every save
A save taken although the desk was on an older version

steps.action: Another desk had saved first (the desk’s version is old)
user_sees: The server refuses; the desk fetches the other desk’s rows and does the action again on top, by itself
The receipt gets the next free number
must_not: The person seeing an error for a clash the panel can settle by itself
The first desk’s rows overwritten

start: A desk holding one save that never got an answer; nobody touches the panel

steps.action: The regular refresh runs (about every 15 seconds)
user_sees: The kept save is sent again with the same id; the server answers with the version it already gave or takes it now
The screen shows the record as saved
must_not: A second copy of the record
The refresh painting older rows over a change the desk just made

start: The server answering a desk it will not serve

steps.action: A desk saves with a key that no longer opens the gym
user_sees: The desk is signed out and the copy of the gym kept on that device is removed
must_not: The gym still readable on that device
What is waiting to be sent from that device thrown away

steps.action: A desk saves while the gym is suspended or its plan is read-only
user_sees: A plain message that says why; nothing is saved
must_not: The record shown as saved
The same save retried in a loop

start: A save whose answer was lost after the server kept it

steps.action: The desk sends the very same save again (same id, same rows) before saying it failed
user_sees: The server answers with the version it already gave
must_not: The payment kept a second time

steps.action: The person presses the same payment sheet again (a new save, same press id)
user_sees: The record with that press id is found and handed back
must_not: A second receipt id and number for one press

steps.action: The server never had the first save (it answers that the version is old)
user_sees: The save is treated like one made with no internet and sent in order
must_not: The save dropped as if it had landed

start: The server handing rows to a signed-in desk

steps.action: A desk asks for the rows changed since its version
user_sees: Rows of the gym its key belongs to, and nothing else
must_not: A row of another gym in the answer
Rows handed out for a key that was signed out

steps.action: A Staff desk sends money another person took
user_sees: The record keeps the name of who really took it
must_not: The sender written as taker of someone else’s money
